title: AI Chat
context: Your AI advisor helps you plan.

goalDialog.title: What do you want from this conversation?
goalDialog.body: Pick one goal. Your AI advisor shapes the conversation around it.

empty.title: No conversations yet.
empty.body: Start one and your AI advisor will help you plan.

transcript.failedPartial: The reply stopped before it finished. Your text above is kept.
transcript.constitution: The AI advisor explains and drafts. Your advisor approves. Only you can submit.

toolRow.applied: Your AI advisor updated your plan.

submitCard.title: Ready to submit?
submitCard.body: Your AI advisor found your plan looks complete. Submitting runs the real checks, the registration window and validation, then sends the plan to your advisor for review. Your AI advisor never submits on its own; you can always submit from the Plan Builder.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm submission?
confirmDialog.body: This confirms you want to submit. Your next message lets your AI advisor submit the plan through the normal checks. Your advisor then reviews it.

submitCard.armed: Submission confirmed. Send a message and your AI advisor will submit your plan.
submitCard.resultSubmitted: Your plan was submitted for review.

quota.banner: You have used your conversation limit for this term. You can still edit and submit your plan in the Plan Builder.
